title: Fish wraps
content:
# Fish wraps

Type: Food | Internal ID: FishWraps | Source: Cauldron, (level 4) | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Cooked fish x2, Barley flour x4 | Max Health: 70 | Max Stamina: 23 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 4 hp/tick

# Introduction

Fish wraps are a Plains-tier food.

## Recipe

Fish wraps are produced in a Level 4 Cauldron with:
• 2 Cooked fish
• 4 Barley flour

Categorias: Food, Fishing
